lines.text: So anyways that’s the opening cutscene of the game. Agent Forty-JeffM is underwater for a long time after a helicopter crash.
Thanks again for coming by on such short notice to film a studio tour. It’s an exciting time with our game Parasocial Activity streaming on MinnHax tomorrow! I'm Richard by the way. Nice to meet you.
Feel free to grab some footage of my apartment. I’ll stay here on the couch because I have to play Hitman Freelancer. If you have any questions just shout, and I’ll answer from here.
Thanks again for dropping by! That’s my wife Yu over in the kitchen. Upstairs is my computer where I made this game.
